column1: The Hindu Time Machine - Open Source Database
This workbook lists every event on the timeline and the sources behind it. It is published openly so that anyone can check the content.
Sheet 'Cards': every event with its date, region, category and the text shown on the site. 'Card ID' links the two sheets.

Sheet 'Sources': every source for every card. Types: Primary source (the text, inscription, chronicle, document or excavation report the claim rests on); Scholarly book; Journal article / chapter; Reference (Wikipedia).
Dates: plain years are attested; 'c.' marks a scholarly estimate; '(traditional)' marks Purāṇic, Siddhāntic or sampradāya reckoning.

How the sources were compiled: references were drafted with AI research assistance, then every book and article was checked automatically against Open Library and Crossref, and every reference article against Wikipedia. Anything that could not be found was removed. Primary-source citations give the work and, where certain, the locus; the link opens a search for editions and translations.
